translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Ahero Jehova Nyasaye nikech nowinjo kwayona;
nowinjo ywakna kane adwaro kech.
Nikech ne ochikona ite,
abiro luonge kinde duto ma angima.
Tonde mag tho norida, lit mar liel nochopona,
kendo chandruok gi chuny lit noloya.
Eka naluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye, ne aywakne niya,
“Resa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye!”
Jehova Nyasaye ngʼwon kendo timo maber;
Nyasachwa opongʼ gi kech.
Jehova Nyasaye rito joma chunygi obolore;
kane an-gi chando maduongʼ to ne oresa.
Bed abeda mos, yaye chunya,
nimar Jehova Nyasaye osebedo katimoni maber ndalo duto.
Nimar in ema isegolo chunya e tho, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
wengena bende isereso e ywak,
kendo tiendena isegengʼo mondo kik okier,
isetimo kamano mondo awuothi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye,
e piny joma ngima.
Ne ayie; emomiyo ne awacho niya,
“Sand oromo chunya.”
Kendo kane achiedh-nade omaka,
to ne awacho niya, “Dhano duto riambo.”
Ere kaka dachul Jehova Nyasaye
kuom berne duto mosetimona?
Abiro tingʼo okumba mar warruok malo
kendo abiro luongo nying Jehova Nyasaye.
Abiro chopo singruokga ma asetimo ne Jehova Nyasaye
e nyim ji duto.
Tho mar nyithind Nyasaye
en gima ber miwuoro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, an jatichni adier;
an jatichni, ma wuod jatichni ma nyako;
isegonya mi igola e nyorochena.
Abiro timoni misango mar erokamano
kendo abiro luongo nying Jehova Nyasaye.
Abiro chopo singruokga
ma asetimo ne Jehova Nyasaye e nyim ji duto,
abiro chopogi e lache mag od Jehova Nyasaye
abiro timogi e iyi, yaye Jerusalem.
Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye!
